units.source_text: ……乘务员来回通报前方站是西舞鹤，声音把我惊醒了。

en.t: ...The conductor kept announcing that the next station was Nishi-Maizuru, and his voice woke me with a start.

units.source_text: 如今，乘客中已经没有那些匆匆挑行李的水兵了。

en.t: By now, there were no longer any sailors among the passengers hurriedly shouldering their luggage.

units.source_text: 除了我以外，只有两三个黑市商人模样的男人开始做下车的准备。

en.t: Aside from me, only two or three men who looked like black-market traders had begun getting ready to get off.
